meta.title: Toronto mental health service planning
meta.snapshot: STA313 project snapshot; health and facility reference dates not supplied
meta.method: Percent ranks use minimum rank for ties, divided by n−1. Need = rank(MHA rate). Disconnection = mean(rank(living alone), rank(low income)). Access gap = mean(rank(nearest-facility km), 1−rank(facility count)). Default score = .45×Need + .35×Disconnection + .20×Access gap. Distance uses an on-surface representative point in EPSG:3978, matching the R source approach. Geometry simplification affects display only.
